messages:
leo: Quiet win update — midnight soft-launch went smooth. First 24h: ~2.3M requests, no major alerts. Cake in the kitchen at 4pm? :cake: :tada:
nina: Yesss. Ill bring candles and my very off-key 'launch anthem' (30s).
sam: Playlist? I made a quick 'serving-vibes' playlist: https://spotify.link/fake (open to additions)
jas: Poll: pizza or sushi? Reply with \"pizza\" or \"sushi\"
tanya: pizza (and gf slice pls)
ops-bot: infra-check: all clusters stable; avg P99 latency 180ms; error rate 0.01% no regressions ✅
leo: Huge props to eng-runtime & eng-sre. @comms-bot can you draft a 1-2 line internal shoutout?
comms-bot: Draft prepared: \"Team shipped partner launch (dedicated-hosted) — 24h stable at ~2.3M requests. Massive thanks to infra & product teams.\" Will flag legal if needed.
nina: I'll bring a mini banner and napkins.
sam: pizza
jas: sushi
tanya: pizza
leo: Tally: pizza 3, sushi 1 pizza wins. Ordering from Pizzeria Luna unless objections.
nina: Also shoutout to support who handled onboarding calls like champs. Virtual hugs :hugging_face: everyone.
ops-bot: kitchen reserved 4:00-4:30pm. Keep it short for the next team booking.
leo: Remote folks: we'll do a quick screenshots montage and upload to #team-photos afterward.
sam: GIF: :partyparrot:
comms-bot: Reminder: do not share customer-identifying details externally. Use \"partner launch\" and approved comms wording only.
nina: If you want the playlist, DM me \"vibes\" and Ill add you.
jas: I'll bring a tiny ukulele for the off-key anthem.
leo: Drop a thumbs emoji if you're in for 4pm.
sam: :thumbsup:
nina: :thumbsup:

comms-bot: Internal announce posted. Congrats again team!"
